summary: Core Molding Technologies filed an 8-K on July 7, 2026, disclosing a Third Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement with Huntington National Bank. The amendment upsizes the revolving credit facility from $25M to $50M, adds a $50M delayed-draw term loan, reduces the applicable margin by 55–30 bps, extends maturity by five years, and modifies EBITDA add-backs for Mexico relocation and executive retirements. There is no change of control, no acquisition or divestiture, and no shareholder vote triggered. This is a routine credit-refinancing event, not a special situation.
